title: Rhinoplasty (nose job)
what: The surgeon changes the shape of the nose: bone, cartilage, and soft tissue. Sometimes the septum is straightened at the same time to make breathing easier.
why: When you are unhappy with the shape of your nose, from an injury or by nature, or breathing through your nose is hard.
duration: surgery usually takes 2 to 3 hours; you usually stay at the clinic until the next day
tell_doctor: All your medicines, especially blood thinners. Your doctor will say what to stop and when
Allergies to medicines, latex, or iodine
What exactly you want to change. Show it on photos

prepare.title: Tests
prepare.text: Blood tests, an ECG, and sometimes a GP checkup. The clinic will give you a list.

prepare.title: Anesthetist
prepare.text: Before surgery, an anesthetist will talk with you. Tell them about your health and medicines.

prepare.title: Food and water
prepare.text: Usually no food from the night before and no drinks for a few hours. The clinic will tell you the exact time.

prepare.title: Home
prepare.text: Have a high pillow and cold compresses ready. For the first days, you will breathe through your mouth.

bring: Clothes with buttons or a zip
steps: The surgeon goes over the plan with you once more
Cuts are made inside the nose, or a small cut between the nostrils
The surgeon reshapes the bone and cartilage
Packing or soft splints may be placed in the nose
A cast or plastic splint is placed on the bridge of the nose
feel: Your nose is blocked, and you breathe through your mouth. This is temporary
Swelling and bruising under the eyes for 1 to 2 weeks
Headache and heaviness. You will get painkillers
after: Packing usually comes out after 1 to 3 days, the splint after about a week
No nose blowing, bending, or heavy lifting. Your doctor will say for how long
No glasses resting on your nose until your doctor allows
The final shape shows after 6 to 12 months
red_flags: A heavy nosebleed: call emergency services
A fever over 38°C (100.4°F), or growing pain and swelling
Worse vision or a severe headache: see a doctor right away

faq.q: When will I see the result?
faq.a: Most swelling goes in a few weeks, but the final shape shows after 6 to 12 months.

faq.q: Can I wear glasses after surgery?
faq.a: Usually not right away. Pressure on the nose gets in the way. Your surgeon will say when.

reminders.text: Rhinoplasty tomorrow. Have a high pillow and cold packs ready. Eat and drink only until the time the clinic gave you.
